youtube.title: Earth Disappears in 50 Seconds (Scale of the Universe) #shorts
youtube.description:
This is Earth. Keep your eyes on it.

Jupiter → the Sun → Betelgeuse → Stephenson 2-18 → TON 618, the most massive black hole we know. Every jump is to scale.

Comment which one broke your brain 🧠
Tomorrow: smaller than an atom.

#shorts #space #astronomy #universe #scale #blackhole #TON618 #cosmicscale

lines.text: This is Earth.
lines.caption: THIS IS *EARTH*

lines.text: In {N} seconds, it will disappear.
lines.caption:
IN *{N} SECONDS*
IT DISAPPEARS

lines.text: Jupiter.
lines.caption: *JUPITER*

lines.text: Thirteen hundred Earths fit inside.
lines.caption:
*1,321 EARTHS*
FIT INSIDE

lines.text: The Sun.
lines.caption: *THE SUN*

lines.text: One thousand Jupiters.
lines.caption: *1,000* JUPITERS

lines.text: Earth is now a speck of dust.
lines.caption:
EARTH IS NOW
*A SPECK OF DUST*

lines.text: But the Sun is a dot, next to Betelgeuse.
lines.caption:
THE SUN IS A DOT
NEXT TO *BETELGEUSE*

lines.text: Put it where our Sun is, and it swallows Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars.
lines.caption:
IT SWALLOWS
*MERCURY · VENUS
EARTH · MARS*

lines.text: Our Sun is still on screen. Pause. Try to find it.
lines.caption:
⏸ PAUSE
*FIND THE SUN*

lines.text: Now meet Stephenson two-eighteen. The largest known star.
lines.caption:
*STEPHENSON 2-18*
THE LARGEST KNOWN STAR

lines.text: Ten billion Suns fit inside.
lines.caption:
*10 BILLION* SUNS
FIT INSIDE

lines.text: Light itself needs nine hours to travel around it.
lines.caption:
LIGHT NEEDS *9 HOURS*
TO GO AROUND IT

lines.text: And it still isn't the biggest thing out there.
lines.caption:
STILL NOT
*THE BIGGEST*

lines.text: Ton six-eighteen.
lines.caption: *TON 618*

lines.text: A black hole with the mass of sixty-six billion Suns.
lines.caption:
*66 BILLION*
SUNS

lines.text: Our entire solar system fits inside it.
lines.caption:
OUR *SOLAR SYSTEM*
FITS INSIDE

lines.text: Forty times over.
And Earth? Still in there. A dot, on a dot, on a dot.
lines.caption:
AND EARTH?
A DOT ON A DOT
*ON A DOT*

lines.text: Comment which one broke your brain.
lines.caption:
COMMENT 🧠
*WHICH ONE BROKE
YOUR BRAIN?*

lines.text: Tomorrow, we go smaller than an atom.
lines.caption:
TOMORROW:
*SMALLER THAN AN ATOM*

facts.sources: Jupiter≈1,321 Earths by volume; Sun≈986 Jupiters by volume; Betelgeuse R≈764 R☉ (Joyce et al. 2020); Stephenson 2-18 R≈2,150 R☉ (Fok et al. 2012); TON 618 M≈6.6×10^10 M☉ (Shemmer et al. 2004), r_s≈1,300 AU, diameter≈2,600 AU ≈ 43× Neptune's orbital diameter; light around Stephenson 2-18: 2π·10 AU ≈ 8.7 h.
